title: The sheep who got the small half
_map: Halves that look different (Y1). Big idea: a half is 1 of 2 equal parts, whatever it looks like. Creative: cut a square field in half as many different ways as he can.
_story: Steve wants to share a square field between two sheep. It cuts it unfairly first (a sheep complains). Ismaeel finds halves that look completely different but are still fair.
_stepChain: sharing fairly (fair-shares) → cut a field into 2 → an unfair cut: one part bigger → 2 equal parts are called halves → halves can look different: strips, triangles → test: is it 2 equal parts?

talk.goodAnswer: it's one of two equal parts; both parts must be the same size.

talk.ask: Can two halves look different from another pair of halves?
talk.goodAnswer: yes: a square cut down the middle or corner to corner both make halves.

handsOn: Fold a square of paper in half in as many different ways as you can. Are all your halves really halves? How can you check?

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Two sheep want to share this square field. Baa! I'll cut it into two parts. Snip!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: There! Oh. One sheep is cross. Baa! That's not fair! Your part is bigger! Hmm. It is bigger.
To be fair, both parts must be exactly the same size. When something is cut into 2 equal parts, each part is called a half. Half for you, half for me!
Here's something surprising. Halves can look different! Cut across the other way. Or corner to corner, making two triangles! They look different, but every time, it's 2 equal parts.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Is this a half? I cut it into 2 parts, so it must be a half!

question.prompt: Is Steve's shaded part a half?
question.onRight: Yes, you spotted it! 2 parts isn't enough. They must be 2 equal parts!

0.hint: Look at the sizes. Are the two parts the same?
0.say: There are 2 parts. But look, one is much bigger! Halves must be equal. So this isn't a half.

question.reveal: Not a half! The parts aren't equal.

rule.text: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts.
rule.ask: What makes something a half? Say it out loud! Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A half is one of two equal parts. Halves can look different, as long as both parts are the same size.

bonus.prompt: Bonus! Can you cut a square in half with a wiggly line?
bonus.reveal: Yes! If the wiggle goes through the middle, the same on both sides, both parts are equal. Halves can be any shape!
